why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_catch items, and it handles both. Item 1 (line 4): Check 4 says "The live page can only be seen after merge; do not fetch it." It then reads .github/workflows/pages.yml and docs/index.md at the PR head. To pass, the workflow must still publish docs/ on push to main and docs/index.md must list --shout. Item 2 (line 2): Check 2 runs the program without --shout at the head. It then gets the same outputs from the code before the change ("git worktree add /tmp/greet-base <merge-base of the PR>" or the base bin/greet.js) and compares them. It fails if "any output or exit code differs from the base when --shout is not given." This goes further than comparing against a hand-written string. Both items are covered.
